title: headphone cueing
system_instruction_addendum: HEADPHONE CUEING ADDENDUM: The cue button routes a deck to the headphones only. Master and headphone cue can differ: that is the point.

tutor_speak.text: the headphone cue button routes a deck to your headphones only: the room hears master, you hear the cued deck.
tap the headphone cue toggle on deck A.

hints.text: the headphone cue toggle sits in the mixer column above the channel fader.
it usually carries a headphone glyph or the word CUE.
press the headphone cue button on the deck A column.
